concepts.plainMeaning: Liquid 3-month futures on $1,000,000 dollar rates quoted via 100 minus annualized rate R.
concepts.roleHere: Historical workhorse hedging short-term interest rates out to 10 years.
concepts.analogy: A standardized 90-day interest lock thermometer moving inverse to market yields.

concepts.plainMeaning: Modern Treasury-backed overnight interest benchmark powering Three-Month SOFR futures.
concepts.roleHere: Current risk-free short-rate standard replacing legacy LIBOR.
concepts.analogy: The central overnight Treasury interest barometer guiding global contracts.

concepts.plainMeaning: Daily cash profit or loss transferred immediately as futures settlement quotes shift.
concepts.roleHere: Reinvestment of variation margin drives futures rates above forward rates.
concepts.analogy: Settling scorecard wins daily in cash instead of waiting until the match ends.

concepts.plainMeaning: Half sigma squared T1 T2 deduction converting daily-settled futures rates into unbiased forward rates.
concepts.roleHere: Essential correction before using long-dated futures inside zero curves.
concepts.analogy: Subtracting wind-drift bias before trusting long-range compass readings.

concepts.plainMeaning: Market price multiplied by duration measuring dollar value sensitivity per unit yield move.
concepts.roleHere: Numerator and denominator matching inside duration hedge N*.
concepts.analogy: Total cargo weight times lever arm needed to balance a seesaw exactly.

concepts.plainMeaning: Bank discipline matching duration of long loan assets against short customer deposits.
concepts.roleHere: Practical corporate treasury application of duration futures hedging.
concepts.analogy: Balancing long mortgages against short checking deposits so rate hikes don't crush equity.

concepts.plainMeaning: Uniform yield curve jump affecting short, medium, and long maturities identically.
concepts.roleHere: Key assumption behind duration hedges that breaks under curve steepening.
concepts.analogy: Every floor of an elevator rising the exact same height simultaneously.

concepts.plainMeaning: Eligible Treasury bond minimizing delivery cost to the short seller in a futures basket.
concepts.roleHere: Benchmark bond whose duration sets Treasury futures contract sensitivity in duration hedges.
concepts.analogy: The exact bond driving futures price sensitivity during rate moves.
